text:
kevin: heads up - customers reported a weird dip in cache savings right after the canary swap. noticed on the per-tenant card.
linh: saw that in staging. the slab shows -12% savings immediately after rollout. looks like prefetch credits vanished.
drew: likely attribution key mismatch. our credit rows are keyed by model_sku. when variant changes sku the ledger treats it as new.
kevin: pm wants a clearer explanation for customers. we should either consolidate credits across variants or show an explicit transfer.
pm-olivia: (PM) prefer explicit transfer trace so ops can see what moved, but also need a concise default view for regular customers.
linh: proposal: introduce a "variant transfer" row type in econ export with fields: rollout_id, from_sku, to_sku, amount, ts. consumers can render a small transfer badge.
drew: backend sketch: emit transfer events from rollout service to econ-topic. add a compact daily lookup table map rollouts->{from:to}. econ-stream API will accept flag `show_transfers=true`. sample: GET /internal/econ?start=1712680000&end=1712685000&show_transfers=true
kevin: UX: default UI hides transfers, but show a chevron on tenant card: "Transfers (1)" that expands to list. Also add tooltip: "Credits moved due to model variant rollout."
pm-olivia: also ask billing: are transfers additive or neutral? billing asks to keep them visible but not double-bill. so display additive in UI but mark as non-billable transfer in billing export.
linh: implementation note: mark transfer rows with tag `transfer=true` and `billable=false` in the econ export. Keep original credit rows intact.
drew: perf: precomputing daily rollforward map will make streaming join O(1) per row; otherwise heavy.
kevin: alerts: create an econ-alert when net tenant savings delta < -10% within 3h of a rollout and there is no transfer row. Fire to #econ-ops.
ops-bot: infra-bot: rollout-transfer PR opened in #pull-requests (link) - CI green.
kevin: action items: @drew emit transfer events + api flag; @linh add UI expand/collapse + chevron + tooltip; @pm-olivia coordinate billing mapping; I'll write docs update.
linh: will mock the expanded list and post tomorrow.
drew: will open backend PR, estimate 2d.
kevin: thanks all.
